job: Make a proposed design distinguishable from an installed universal shutoff.

styleReference.limit: Rendering only; no people or entire source scene reused.

knownDefects.prevention: Bind the destination style authority and every character identity reference; compare the rendered subject at face and full-body scale.
Bind the exact town/location authority and reject invented geography, people, props or scene roles.
Specify object surfaces, supports, orientations and connections before generation; inspect the real pixels for impossible devices such as a laptop screen on the outside lid.
Specify required bodies and actions before generation; inspect every visible hand, limb, finger, joint and body connection in the real pixels.
Default to clean art with deterministic editable text. If lettering is itself the asset, bind approved copy and compare every character in the rendered output.
Bind scene year, location, character age, wardrobe, accessories, technology and prohibited anachronisms before generation; inspect the rendered pixels.
Bind the exact accompanying words, time window, proposition and visual job. A shared mood or topic is not semantic alignment.
Give every dominant object, person, gesture and overlay a named scene or teaching job; remove anything that distracts, contradicts or merely decorates.

scene: Contemporary anonymous planning desk; no people, town character, real-person identity or named building.
mustShow: Flat sketch rather than working physical switch
Pencil and eraser supporting proposal stage
generation: Built-in image generation, existing subscription; no API or plan purchase
